party.accessHelp: Create a room, then everyone joins on their own phone.
party.mobileHelp: Join the room shown on the television. To set up a party, create its room on the big screen.
party.createDisplay: Create a party on this screen

party.reopenCollection: Reopen submissions with no time limit

party.wheelTitle: Who is selling us their invention?

captions.subtitle: Your line
captions.first: You are writing the start of this story.
captions.private: Your scene stays on your phone until the premiere.
captions.present: Your turn to dub this scene!
captions.manual: Read and perform the dialogue out loud. You control the pace.
captions.voteHelp: Three awards: choose a story, a performer and a line.
captions.adaptations: Excerpts have been shortened, muted and adapted into still frames for EN VRILLE! Players invent their own dialogue.

pitch.title: INVENT THE NEXT REVOLUTIONARY PRODUCT!
pitch.replace: The machine will replace the name and description. Your current text will be lost.
pitch.name: Your invention’s name
pitch.generated: An idea from the machine. You can edit every word.
pitch.rating: Rate the presentation you have just heard.

mythos.name: The Liars’ Show
mythos.rules: Answer an unlikely question, discover the answers and vote for your favourite. Authors stay anonymous and you cannot vote for yourself.

pitch.name: Sell Me This Crap!
pitch.rules: Invent a product or use House Decoy, then sell an invention made by another player. Rate humour, conviction and creativity from 1 to 5 after each presentation.

court.name: The Court of Nonsense
court.rules: Defendant, prosecutor, lawyer, judge and jury: everyone has a role. The jury delivers a secret verdict, and participants can reward the best performance.

who.name: Who Among Us?
who.rules: Secretly pick the person who best fits the question. Then discover the group's choice.

captions.name: Forbidden Subtitles
captions.rules: Movie scenes pass between your phones. Write a line that continues the previous dialogue, then perform a complete story out loud. Vote for best film, best actor and best line.

0.title: One host, one room.
0.body: Create a party, build your programme, choose a nickname and share the code. No account needed.

1.title: Everyone gets a controller.
1.body: Use a browser on your phone or computer. In the same room, open the TV stage. Online, meet your friends in your usual voice call.

2.title: Your party, your rules.
2.body: Build a custom programme or draw a random selection. Adjust timers, votes, categories and the leaderboard.

3.title: Write. Vote. Own it.
3.body: Follow the instructions on your private controller. The stage reveals creations, results and points. Speaking turns always wait for the host's signal.

4.title: The podium remembers.
4.body: Points accumulate across the evening. Tied players share their victory. Reconnecting restores your place.
